name: Ivy
source:
She is a mysterious creature, for sure. Her pointy ears are the first thing that people mention when they refer to people like her as elves, but that is not their only distinctive trait, apparently. Ivy has learned to survive under the glare of the wasteland Sun for many years.

She is quick and extremely agile, which has obviously served her well. She keeps her hair at shoulder length, often covering part of her face as she hides in the shadows. There is just some quality to her that speak of innocence but also a potential for so much more.

[spoiler]Real name is Yuna and she's not a mute, she's very cautious around people [/spoiler]
